Sentence (English): I love my new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I Love It. except for one thing. ] || ---------------- || I love my new dishwasher. My dishes come out clean, no greasy residue. There is a nighttime feature that air dries through the night. There's no water remaining in the tops of cups in the morning when I use this. It has a third drawer on the top that is not very deep, but it is perfect for container lids, overflow silverware, rubber spatulas, sponges, knives, anything flat. There are little teeth in which the silverware can be placed on edge so quite a bit of silverware can be loaded if you aren't using the silverware basket for some reason. The second drawer down (which used to be the top drawer) has four dish separator sections. Two of the divider sections have a side that will lay down flat so you can put in small pans or larger items. The whole drawer can be raised and lowered a few inches to accommodate tall items in either the second drawer or the lower drawer. I really like this option. The makes it more versatile. The bottom drawer holds the silverware basket. I really like this basket as the lid will hold silverware vertically and separated so that they don't nest. Also, there are two separate lids that lift so you can put in small items then close the lid. The small items are now contained so they don't fly. Or you can put in long cooking tools or knives. The bottom basket also has four separator sections. The prong set in two sections each fold down creating a large flat area to accommodate larger items. The bottom drawer is my problem area. It doesn't have a groove for the wheels to glide in which allows it to go off track easily. It slides easily enough when it is not loaded; however, if there is any weight in the drawer, it goes off track. I need to stand directly in front of it and push with both hands to guide it in. If not, it will go off track and will need to be wrestled back in place. Other than that issue, this is an excellent product but couldn't give it five stars as it really has been a problem for me.

We replaced four working and 25-year-old appliances only because we were remodeling. We had considered other products, but mainly wanted to support USA made products. Sentence (English): I bought this to replace an almost ten year old dishwasher that quit drying—and I think it just quit cleaning in general.
Comments (English): [ Could not be any happier with this! ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace an almost ten year old dishwasher that quit drying—and I think it just quit cleaning in general. I looked at several and had it narrowed down to a few but because I was limited on the space it would have to fit in, I pretty much had to go with this one, which was not one of my picks originally. But I am so happy with it and glad I had to choose this one. I've always felt I had to wash my dishes completely before putting them in the dishwasher (to just basically give them a final clean and sanitize)—I just never felt they came out clean. An annoyance of my husbands. So when we got this, my husband insisted I at least give it a try, don't wash the dishes before (what a concept! ). While I'm still skeptical, I have yet to find ANYTHING left on any of the dishes. And it holds so much more than my old dishwasher. I feel like I used to fill it every night and I have yet to really fill this one. The third rack up top is really nice for larger utensils and cup lids. The only thing that could have made this better was if Lowe's could have got their act together and it didn't take nearly TWO months to deliver and install and I could have had it in time for Christmas dinner. Oh well. I love it and would highly recommend!

It also dries much better than the old dishwasher when we use the Extra Dry feature or use the Night Dry feature when we run it later in the evening and won't empty the dishwasher until the next morning. We've been using it for about 2+ weeks now and so far it has been great. It is very quiet. A nice feature is an interior light that goes on when you open the door. The food particle filter is much more easily accessible than on our previous dishwasher. As always, when changing dishwasher brands, it took us a few tries to find the best placement for some of our dishes, bowls etc., but now we've figured out what works best for us. I would highly recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I must say this was an experience I wouldn't want to repeat.
Comments (English): [ Lemons occur but Costco has your back ] || ---------------- || I must say this was an experience I wouldn't want to repeat. I bought the LG dishwasher with the stainless steel interior just in time for Christmas. On Christmas Eve morning the middle draw came off its railing on the left side, I was able to pop it back on. That evening with 16 people for dinner the entire middle draw fell off crushing the wine glasses below. I was still able to use the lower draw and the utensils rack. The day after Christmas I called LG for repair which a 24/48 hr response time was promised from a “authorized repair contractor “ after no response and severe calls I was given a repair call for January 20? They wanted to send me a replacement draw but there's nothing to attach it to on the wall of the dishwasher… I ended the odessy by returning the dishwasher and having another one installed. The installer said in 27 years he'd never seen anything quite like it. He said usually LG is a great product but this wasn't one of them!

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher on a black Friday sale in 2022 because of the low 39-decibel rating.
Comments (English): [ Whisper Quiet Normal Wash ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher on a black Friday sale in 2022 because of the low 39-decibel rating. The express wash cycle runs about an hour and a half, but it is noisier. This dishwasher, which is higher end than my previous Kitchen Aid, was considerably lighter in weight. When we installed it, we noticed that the fittings for the hoses, which were previously metal, are all plastic so we are somewhat concerned about the sturdiness of this model. The unit feels less solid overall, but we will have to see how long it lasts. The last model had a food grinder and this one does not, so that may account for a good deal of the weight difference. The top of the utensil basket does not open, so I have to load of the utensils facing up through individual slots, which slow me down on loading and unloading, but they are coming out clean. I have tested scraping off the food waste from dishes, but not rinsing them and they do come out clean unless something has been dried on for a long while. Be sure to order the installation kit if you are installing it yourself as our old hoses were different sizes and did not fit on the new fittings. One other item to note is that we found water inside the dishwasher when it arrived. (See photos). We were suspicious that we were sent a used model, but customer service assured us that the water is present because they test all the units before shipping them out. I will let readers be the judges of that claim, but other than the water, it arrived safe and sound and is working well.

Sentence (English): I bought this a few weeks ago and I am very pleased with it.
Comments (English): [ Very pleased with this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought this a few weeks ago and I am very pleased with it. I LOVE the 3rd rack. It allows me to wash more and put odd shaped or long items on it such as stove handles, ladles and of large knives. I do not as a rule use it for regular cutlery because the basket below suffices. I wish the basket area on the 3rd shelf was not grooved for cutlery because my big knives and spatulas do not fit in the slots. The basket should be flat in order to be more versatile. Also, the left side of the 3rd rack that does not have a basket should have smaller slots because I fear slimmer items will slip through them. The dishwasher is very quiet and effective in cleaning and drying. Only on 1 occasion I experimented with a very crusted SS pot on the bottom rack without any pre rinsing or soaking. It cleaned about 90% of the charred food. That is the exception rather than the rule because on most items, they come out squeaky clean. The appearance is pleasing and controls are easy to use. I did notice that run time for this dishwasher is very long so if you need dishes quickly, you may need to hand wash. It takes HOURS to run a load on the sensor option. From what I have read, regulations have forced manufacturers to build their dishwashers in such a way that results in longer run time. This seems quite counterintuitive to me. With that said, I still highly recommend this dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Poor follow up installation assistance. ] || ---------------- || I called San Juan PR whirlpool for assistance for a new install. Comments (English): [ Powerful, Efficient, Attractive ] || ---------------- || I've had this black Bosch Ascenta front control dishwasher since Thanksgiving 2022. I am a very happy customer. For about an extra $150 this dishwasher is MUCH quieter. The sound is barely noticed only 12 ft away, making it an excellent choice for my great-room/kitchen combo. I've only used the Express Wash setting so far. Even at this setting partially deglazed pots came out perfectly clean, glassware spotless. My water heater is set at 115 degrees. As with other reviewers, I found loading a bit of a challenge at first. Now that I'm used to where my dishes, etc. fit best, loading is easy. My husband found it easy to do the installation. My favorite part of this dishwasher is that the control panel is in the front, not the top. It stays clean. I also prefer the Bosch control panel buttons instead of the touch panel that was on my old dishwasher. After a few years several of the touch panel areas no longer worked when pressed.

Sentence (English): Yes this DW is quiet.
Comments (English): [ The GOOD and the BAD ] || ---------------- || Yes this DW is quiet. We have two sets of dishes. Both have 11 in plates plus one 8.5 salad bowl and the other has 6.5 salad (soup) bowls. With the middle rack up to fit the 11 in plates, the 8.5 bowl does not fit because of the third top rack. The 6.5 bowls only fit in the front of the middle rack. With the third rack large glasses do not fit in the middle rack toward the back. You CANNOT fit SERVING UTENSILS in the holes where the forks go and have to use the top rack. We put small FABERWARE pots on the left side of the lower rack to see how they cleaned. We used the normal cycle to clean the stuff in the DW. When it was done the handles of one of the FABERWEAR pots had lost its SHINE. The force of the water took off a layer of the handle and it is not smooth anymore. One other point is the bottom of one of the pots was discolored. We have used these pots for many years (yes we are up there in years) and never had these problems from a DW. I guess if you have pots that have metal handles they might be ok. As far as getting items clean I give it a very good but not excellent. The reason is two times out of maybe 20-30 washings food was on two dishes. Maybe I put them in the wrong way.

Make sure that your dealer will fix this if you buy this dishwasher and have this issue. Do not let them tell you that it is "food particles". How many food particles are there after only one use and when the dishes were practically clean when put in the dishwasher?

Sentence (English): We had our previous Bosch dishwasher for about 21 years and it still ran when I replaced it.
Comments (English): [ Runs quietly, cleans thoroughly ] || ---------------- || We had our previous Bosch dishwasher for about 21 years and it still ran when I replaced it. At this point, the only other brand I'd seriously consider would be Miele (if they had a dealer in our area). These dishwashers are excellent, but before you buy you do need to understand the Bosch drying technology. It has pros and cons, which I won't go into here, other than to say that the Zeolite technology in the 800 (and Benchmark) series is an improvement compared to my old dishwasher (which often failed to dry plastics). This dishwasher is very quiet (but not quite silent, which is a good thing IMO). I was afraid I wouldn't like the fact that there is no external display of the cycle's remaining time (only a beam of light on the floor to show it's still running). After using the DW for a few months, I really don't miss the external buttons and indicators. The front panel presents a very clean look with the controls hidden on the upper edge; this also makes it hard/impossible for young children to play with the buttons. One minor quibble: I'm not crazy about the long rectangular recess at the top. I think the narrower, rounded shape of some models looks better. As for operation, the "automatic" cycle works well for general use. It cleans beautifully and *usually* dries thoroughly. When something does not dry on "automatic", it's usually either because (a) the force of water has tipped over a plastic cup and water accumulates inside, or (b) you've failed to load cups/bowls upside down and on an angle, so water cannot not drain off. You can set the middle rack on an angle to aid drainage/drying. The one time I tried the "Speed 60" setting, it cleaned OK but it did not dry too well. Note that on the Automatic/normal setting, a full cycle takes about 2.5 hours, which seems pretty long to me.

Will be keeping an eye on that and checking the Internet for suggestions.

Sentence (English): It takes a little getting used to because the wash cycles take a bit longer.
Comments (English): [ Looks Great, Energy Efficient, and Works Well ] || ---------------- || It takes a little getting used to because the wash cycles take a bit longer. The dishwasher is designed to be energy efficient, so it trades off less water and lower power motors for longer cycles. For example, the Quick cycle takes just under an hour where it took 25 minutes in my old dishwasher. But the results are great. Normal and Quick both do a good job on cookware. I didn't try baked on crusty casserole pans, but skillets and serving bowls come clean with just a quick rinse in the sink before loading them. The dishwasher does use a rinsing agent that works well to avoid water marks on glassware. Regarding the available trays, there's no special features like a separate pull out tray for flatware, but the two trays are roomy and, for the two of us, will hold 3 days of dishes and probably more if we loaded it to full capacity. As for wash cycles, it includes everything you need from Quick to Heavy as well as an extended soak cycle. It includes sanitizing cycles as well. The controls are all accessible from the top of the door, which makes for a nice clean look when the door is closed. You simply make your selection and tap the START button. The cycle will begin when you close the door. Installation is what you would expect; AC power, drain, and water supply. All four feet are adjustable and the instructions come with a guide to tell you at what height to set the feet before you push the dishwasher under the counter. Brackets are included for top or side mounting. And lastly, the dishwasher is very quiet. I'm very satisfied with the design, feature set, and look of the unit.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher in Dec 2021 with Costco 2-year manufacture warranty.
Comments (English): [ Avoid Samsung products if you can! ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in Dec 2021 with Costco 2-year manufacture warranty. On Dec 12, 2022, this dishwasher started showing error message and cannot complete the full cycle. Called Costco Concierge service to set up warranty claim for repair. The request was then sent to Samsung and they kept refusing to process the repair saying the unit is not under their 1-year warrant. However, the fact is that it has 2-year since the unit was bought from Costco. I was so frustrated with Samsung customer service and called back to Costco on Dec29th and had them escalating the issue and I would not get off the phone until they had Samsung accept my repair request under their warranty. After that, Samsung issued my repair ticket scheduled a repair appointment on Jan6th. After first initial diagnostic phone call they determine that they couldn't repair the dishwasher and offering me a refund. For god sake, they absolutely make the process so hard for me to get the refund. After I provided requested information, no communication from them after 4-day of waiting. I called their customer back and asking what is going on and then found out that the pic I provided did not meet their requirement. They need a pic of the sticker being removed from dishwasher and clearly show the serial number. And I need to provide the pic within their timeframe otherwise their system would close the ticket automatically. I ended up reopen the ticket and sent them the pic and they came back saying they can't see the information on the sticker which is absolutely nonsense. Then I sent an enlarged pic of the sticker back to them which it clearly shows the information. As of Jan 18th, I am still waiting this refund to be processed by Samsung. It has been a month! I would not buy any Samsung products for sure moving forward. You don't want to deal with their terrible customer services from India!

Sentence (English): appearance: Simple style, quite satisfactory, and versatile with cabinets.
Comments (English): Appearance: Simple style, quite satisfactory, and versatile with cabinets. Cleaning ability: Wash very clean, bright and clean as new. Logistics speed: Because the desktop computer that has been used for more than ten years broke down, I quickly placed an order and bought this embedded one. I haven’t washed the dishes manually for many years. Noise level: The level in the video is basically negligible when chatting in the living room, and it is not affected when sleeping at night. Washing capacity: A family of four washes twice a day, and once a day there will be a few dishes that cannot fit. After-sales service: I am not satisfied with this. My cabinet is made of marble partitions. The installers can only open holes for pipelines, but they don’t have tools to drill screw holes, and they can’t fix the sides and bottom. In the end, I spent money to hire the master of the property to fix it. I'm just curious, are other people's houses made of wooden cabinets?
Comments (Original): 外形外观：简约风格，中规中矩，和橱柜百搭。清洁能力：洗得很干净，光洁如新。物流速度：因为用了十来年的台式机坏了，火速下单买了这款嵌入式的，好多年没手动洗过碗，真是煎熬啊，京东物流三天到货，解决了燃眉之急。噪音程度：视频里的程度，基本上在客厅聊天可以忽略，晚上睡觉时也不受影响。洗涤容量：一家四口，一天洗两次，一天洗一次就会有几个碗碟放不下了。售后服务：这个有些不满意，我的橱柜是大理石隔板，安装人员只能开管线通孔，但没有工具钻螺丝孔，无法固定两侧和底部，最后我花钱请物业的师傅才搞定，我就好奇了，难道其他人家都是木制橱柜？

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to complete the LG collection in our kitchen, and it's been disappointing on several levels.
Comments (English): [ NOT a good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to complete the LG collection in our kitchen, and it's been disappointing on several levels. It's described as very quiet, and while the wash cycle IS quiet, the water-filling cycles will wake the neighbors. It's shocking how loud it is. We try to run it when we're away from the house. We've had two separate repairmen look at it, exchange valves, check connections, but nothing has improved it.We've also tried the different wash cycles, which take between 2 and 3 hours. That seems long - especially to not clean well! Utensils on the third rack need to be rinsed well before washing. Really, everything should be rinsed well, which is not consistent with the description of "quad wash" and all this dishwasher is supposed to be.Another disappointing feature is the front controls. The dishwasher is under a counter I use for cook prep and I regularly bump the controls. It turns on and off and chimes at me. I've come to ignore it, but it's a nuisance.On the upside, the black stainless is nice and stays clean. Kudos to Lowes: since we bought it on our Lowe's card, the store is replacing it for us. We selected a different brand (our options were limited in black stainless, and we have to wait a month for arrival) but we're hoping for the best. In my experience, skip this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The washer is quiet and cleans great, my only minor gripe is that the racks aren't as well designed as the engineers think.
Comments (English): [ Great cleaning ] || ---------------- || The washer is quiet and cleans great, my only minor gripe is that the racks aren't as well designed as the engineers think. The angled levels on the top rack are narrow and not much can be supported by them. The bottom rack's folding det of tines are way to narrowly spaced, and between those tines and the other is an open area in the middle that is completely useless by itself because there aren't enough wires to support anything. If you have stuff that fits on either side in the tines the middle is left empty. It seems a bit over-engineered in that sense, which is illustrated in the loading recommendations in the manual. Who has dirty dishes in such a tidy and predictable manner? Better to make the racks a bit more general so there's more flexibility in loading. Other than that, it's been great so far.

Sentence (English): We replaced a 21 year old frigadare side by side with the upscale LG french door fridge.
Comments (English): [ From side by side to french door learning curve ] || ---------------- || We replaced a 21 year old frigadare side by side with the upscale LG french door frig. just 17 days ago. It took me a week to decide I needed to rearrange the shelves to better suit our needs and am still reorganizing food placement some. I like having the crispers and deli drawer up where I can see them and the lighting is good. The door shelves are packed and sometimes awkward for getting things, but so were the deeper shelves on the old frig. I was surprised about the "craft Ice" and would have preferred regular ice that could move to the door ice maker if it was running low. Sentence (English): Great dishwasher, much better than 10yr old Frigidaire.
Comments (English): [ Very nice dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher, much better than 10yr old Frigidaire. This new Whirlpool is larger, quieter, easier to load, and baked on food comes out totally clean. Third tray especially deep and helpful. Installation with quick and easy. No problems after one-month, except I do wish the wash cycle was shorter. Regular wash is three hours and nine minutes. I seem to recall that the Whirlpool instructions explained this saves energy and water. We have mostly adapted to this limit, and It does have a quick wash cycle (about one hour and 15 minutes) which appears to work fine and we sometimes use. With more experience with dirtier dishes we may use it more often. Although I gave it 5-stars, this is so preliminary because I have little experience with long-term reliability. The real test is does it still work this well for the next ten years.

Comments (English): [ Bosch Used To Be Good , Maybe 30 years Ago ] || ---------------- || This is my experience with Bosch Dishwashers…. It was my second Bosch dishwasher. The first started showing problems after 3 years of use so I decided to get the top of the line Bosch Benchmark hoping there would be better quality. It turned out a very bad choice. The Benchmark "top of the line" stopped working after 18 months of the installation. First the problem was with the fan. Technician came in, changed the part, it did not fix the issue, and told me to buy a new one. Then I reached out to Bosch, and they sent me a Bosch employee to look at it. It took months for him to come. He said the problem was with the Control unit. A few more weeks waiting for the part. He changed the part and the problem was fixed. It lasted two weeks. Bosch recommended another engineer, who came in, opened the unit, reconnected a few things, saw nothing wrong and fixed the problem. Three weeks later the problem was back. Called the same company Bosch recommended who sent another engineer. This time this one told me the problem was with the Control unit again. I told him we just changed the control unit a few weeks ago but he said parts can come with problems. Note that all professionals that came in (recommended by Bosch), they all had to call some master engineer at Bosch for advice while inspecting the unit. They don't seem they know what they are doing, really. Anyway, I had enough at this point. After months of wait, tons of money spent trying to fix it, I should have listened to the first technician who came in. I got myself a new dishwasher from another brand. So far so good. I would stay away from Bosch dishwashers. Bosch produces bad products, bad parts, unqualified technicians, etc. It is hard to believe they have good reputation of dishwasher manufacturer. All this talk about Bosch technology and quality are lies, just like the Volkswagen scandal. Their appliances are as good as any cheap bad ones on the streets but they do charge through the roof for it.

Sentence (English): This came in about a month ago.
Comments (English): [ Not thrilled ] || ---------------- || This came in about a month ago. Granted, I was not present for the installation so it's possible there was something I missed, but here's what I've learned thus far. 1) there is no clear place to pour the detergent. There's a well that would seem like the obvious place, but the cover that slides over it is labeled "pre-wash," which to me does not = detergent. However, that seems to be where the detergent goes. 2) this machine works best with POWDER detergent. Apparently, the tech who handled installation DID say that but the message wasn't conveyed to me and I found out the hard way. Liquids and gels do not distribute or dissolve easily, leaving dishes dirty AND a messy glob of residual detergent behind. That's incredibly inconvenient given how hard it is to find powder detergent these days, but I managed to track down a box. I've since done a single load with powder and there was marked improvement but that requirement should be much more prominent. Other reviewers have already talked about the long wash cycles and the wet dishes after "drying" so, suffice to say, they are not wrong.

Sentence (English): The two things we were particularly looking for in a replacement dishwasher were: cleaning and quietness.
Comments (English): [ A quiet dishwasher that cleans well ] || ---------------- || The two things we were particularly looking for in a replacement dishwasher were: cleaning and quietness. This Maytag has them both in spades. Also on our list were reliability, water usage, and variety of wash cycles. This model has all of those as well. Those are the positive elements. On the negative side, after reading about the dishwasher I was expecting to have folding tines in the baskets. This Costco model does not. There is a 3rd basket for small cups and flatware. It has very limited use and we could have given up that basket to allow greater height in what is now a middle basket. Rolling the bottom basket in and out is not smooth and it jumps the track on occasion. You must be precise in the way you push it in if you want the rollers to stay on their tracks. The middle basket connects to the water supply with a”plug” on the back. Getting it to plug in correctly is frequently a struggle requiring backing up and trying again and pushing much harder than it should (IMHO). All in all the positives in this Maytag dishwasher outweigh the negatives. So I recommend it.

And there is no heating element so the dishes are wet when finished. The only way to dry them is to shake all the racks as soon as the cycle is over. We are very disappointed and will donate it and buy a different brand.
